goal: Auto-close linked handoffs on task stamp. When 'gad tasks stamp <task-id> --status done|cancelled' fires, scan .planning/handoffs/{open,claimed}/ for handoffs whose frontmatter task_id matches; for each match, run the equivalent of 'gad handoffs complete <handoff-id>' (move open|claimed -> closed, append an Auto-closed section to the body). Idempotent: if already closed, no-op. Logged to .planning/.gad-log/ like other operations.
